input.quote: 19.4 For breach of Section 19.1 or 19.2, Vendor shall promptly re-perform, repair, or replace the nonconforming item at no charge. If Vendor cannot do so within a reasonable period, Customer may terminate the affected item and receive a refund of Fees paid for it. This remedy is not exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security, or indemnified claims.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets the preferred position on every material term: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel to industry standards (19.1); Deliverables materially conform to documentation and acceptance criteria for ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, and Hosted Services conform throughout the subscription term (19.2) — equal to or better than the preferred 12-month software / 90-day services benchmark; no malicious code and compliance with Applicable Law are covered (19.3); and the remedy is re-performance, repair or replacement with termination plus refund of Fees paid as an escalation, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, IP, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims (19.4). The disclaimer in 19.5 is mutual and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranty; there is no "AS IS" language anywhere in the document. Section 6.2 supplies additional acceptance-stage correction and refund mechanics. No redline needed.
